eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor, cam = g.engine.camera; const K = g.deer; for (let i = K.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) K.release(i); K.frozen = true; let spot = null; for (let a = 0; a < 6.28 && !spot; a += 0.08) { const x = p.position.x + Math.cos(a) * 60, z = p.position.z + Math.sin(a) * 60; const y = g.terrain.heightAt(x, z) + 1.2; const dir = new V(x - cam.position.x, y - cam.position.y, z - cam.position.z).normalize(); const dist = Math.hypot(x - cam.position.x, z - cam.position.z); if (g.terrain.raycast(cam.position, dir, dist) < dist) continue; if (g.chunks.raycastObstacles(cam.position, dir, dist).kind) continue; if (!g.chunks.isClear(x, z, 2)) continue; spot = { x, z }; } if (!spot) return 'sem linha de visão livre a 60 m'; const d = K.spawn(new V(spot.x, 0, spot.z), p.yaw + Math.PI, 1.1, 0); d.pose('forage', 0); const aim = d.zonePoint('chest', new V()); const e = cam.position; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(aim.x - e.x), -(aim.z - e.z)); p.pitch = Math.atan2(aim.y - e.y, Math.hypot(aim.x - e.x, aim.z - e.z)); p.update(1 / 30); cam.updateMatrixWorld(); const dir2 = cam.getWorldDirection(new V()); const semVeado = (() => { const i = K.active.indexOf(d); K.release(i); const v = g.hunting.measure(e, dir2); K.active.push(d); return +v.toFixed(1); })(); return { distanciaRealDoVeado: +e.distanceTo(aim).toFixed(1), telemetroComOVeado: +g.hunting.measure(e, dir2).toFixed(1), oQueTemAtrasDele: semVeado }; })()
